title: Post-commit timeout converges through authoritative readback
given: A canonical specimen projection has stable request identity REQUEST-1042.
The configured vendor commits the projection and delays the response beyond the client deadline.
when: The adapter records an ambiguous outcome and queries the vendor by stable request identity.
then: Readback returns the committed vendor object and its canonical payload digest.
Reconciliation closes the request as committed.
The vendor contains one scientifically coherent specimen projection.
material_effect: The scientist sees one authoritative specimen while operations retain a complete recovery trail.

recovery.replacement_behavior: Read authoritative vendor state, reconcile the digest, and route divergent content to the owned quarantine queue.
recovery.verification: The recovery receipt binds the request identity, readback, digest comparison, and final disposition.
